desc:
BETA launch. Expect some bugs and join our community dc below and help support :) 
Hope you enjoy

The skies belong to no one.

War has erupted between the Kingdom of Valrusia and the Sovereignty of Bacara; two nations fighting for very different visions of the world below.

Take to the skies in a large scale aerial combat game built around intense dogfights, coordinated attacks, and destructible battlefields. Fly fighters, interceptors, bombers, and attack aircraft as the war unfolds across contested fronts.

Bacara fights through discipline, industry, and air superiority.
Valrusia fights for freedom, survival, and a sky without boundaries.


---
Controls:
V - FPV
C- Camera
Alt - Unlock Mouse
WASD/QE - Move
Mouse - Move
Left Click - Fire
Right Click - Zoom
